description: This Java source file defines the ServiceEcaAction class, which encapsulates actions related to Service Event-Condition-Action (ECA) within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages invocation of services based on specific events, handling parameters, execution modes, error processing, and result propagation.

classes.name: ServiceEcaAction
classes.description: Represents an ECA action that triggers a specific service in response to an event, with configurable behavior for transaction, error handling, and result mapping. Implements Serializable and provides methods to execute the configured service action.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: getServiceMode
methods.description: Returns the mode in which the service should run ('sync' or 'async').

methods.name: isPersist
methods.description: Indicates whether the action's results should be persisted.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the action, including service name, mode, and persistence.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action based on the current context, handling success, failure, errors, result mapping, and error message propagation.
